title: Launcher
yoloHint: Checked: skip permission prompts this launch; unchecked: follow launch profile
effortHint: Claude injects a thinking budget (MAX_THINKING_TOKENS); Codex uses model_reasoning_effort; Grok uses --reasoning-effort
optionUnsupported: {{cli}} does not support this option — setting it has no effect
initialPromptPlaceholder: First prompt sent automatically after launch (first start only)…
providerNoneCompatible: Add a compatible Provider in Provider management first
argsPreviewApproximate: Approximate preview — the backend command is authoritative
errorNoProject: Select a project or directory first
errorProviderRequired: Select a CC-Panes Provider before launching
errorPiSshUnsupported: Pi runs only in a local or WSL environment
errorOmpSshUnsupported: Oh My Pi runs only in a local or WSL environment
errorJcodeSshUnsupported: Jcode runs only in a local or WSL environment
errorResolveFailed: Failed to resolve launch options ({{code}}); check workspace environment settings
scenarioHint: Applying a template overwrites the append prompt / effort / verbose; later manual edits stick
injectionNeedProject: Select a project first to list skills
injectionTruncated: Content exceeds 8 KB and was truncated
worktreeUnavailableRemote: Local environment only (worktree launch is not supported for WSL/SSH)
worktreeUnavailableNotGit: This directory is not a Git repository
launchSettingsReadFailed: Could not read Git information. Reopen settings to retry.
worktreeCleanBaseHint: Creates from the selected committed revision. Uncommitted edits stay in the original directory.
worktreeCurrentBranchHint: This directory keeps its current branch. Enable a new worktree to choose a different base branch.
worktreeBranchRequired: Enter a branch name for the new worktree
worktreeNewSessionOnly: New worktrees are for new sessions. Resume sessions in their original directory.
remoteEnvPasswordUnsupported: Password-auth machines can't run remote chats yet
remoteEnvRoutedUnsupported: Machines behind a proxy or jump host can't run remote chats yet
remoteEnvEmpty: No SSH machines yet. Add one in the Devices view.
remoteEnvUnreachable: Connectivity check failed: {{message}}. You can still try to start.
worktreePickProject: The workspace root isn't a Git repository. Choose one of its projects for the worktree.
taskPlaceholder: First message sent to the agent after launch. Leave empty to just open the session. ⌘/Ctrl + Enter to launch
yoloInherent: {{cli}} has no permission prompts; it always runs fully automatically
